The Moonlit Winter Garden

White camellias, pale blue hydrangeas and silver ferns frame a snowy valley at night, where two small white deer stand in a distant clearing beneath a crescent moon and a sky of gentle golden stars. Painted with a soft gouache-and-watercolour feel, and sized to your wall.
